description:

Now they also mention the nonbinding catalogue-QA inquiry for migration agencies, and they say "no paid orders on this page" and "tested on synthetic data only". - Undoing the two edits gives back the live page exactly (sha256 57b7f257...).

**Review status:** The dry run (TASK-179429976112) gave digest 9db3d9c1... and index sha256 a51b56a4.... I created the review mission CATALOGUE-METADATA-REVIEW for AUDITOR. My first handoff message was refused because I included an invalid extra field. The corrected message is queued in the actions below. Nothing has been deployed.

**Where things stand:**

- **What waits on that:** deployment needs an independent APPROVE of this exact digest. Exposure and conversion stay unobserved after that.
- **What I concluded:** this is only a presentation fix. The main limit on revenue is still that we can't reach buyers ourselves; the email drafts in NO-COMMUNITY-ANSWER-ACCOUNT wait for the operator to approve them.
